role: regulatory policy analyst responding to public comments on a federal rule
target: the public comments and the proposed/final regulation
inline_evidence_example: the phrase "commenter failed to consider the statutory MSY requirement" is a complaint that evidences an 'evidentiary rigor' norm; the phrase "we balance worker safety against compliance burden" is an observation that evidences a 'benefit-cost balancing' norm; the phrase "§ 304(e) requires us to set the harvest level at or below the MSY estimate, regardless of cost" is an observation that evidences a 'statutory mandate primacy' norm
polarity_hint: Agency responses tilt heavily toward substantive defense of the regulation (responses argue WHY the rule is what it is). A smaller subset (~15-25%) explicitly critiques comment quality ('the commenter failed to consider X'). Capture both: norms invoked in agency reasoning AND norms applied to evaluate commenter arguments.
